subject: Recap: token targets & proposed model blend (next steps)
body:
From: alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com
To: Sofia Chen <sofia.chen@glossai.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, dev.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2027 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap: token targets & proposed model blend (next steps)

Hi Sofia — great conversation earlier. Quick written recap so we all have the same page and clear next steps.

Key takeaways from our call:
- Pilot scope: integrate chat + embeddings + rerank for search personalization pilot.
- Expected usage (pilot -> 6mo ramp): pilot ~500k tokens/month, target steady-state ~2.5M tokens/month (range 1.2M–3.5M).
- GlossAI budget range expressed roughly $3k–$6k/month initially; target unit economics target asked: ~$1,100 per 1M tokens (you said ballpark).
- Model preferences: client expects embeddings-heavy signals for ranking; they estimated embeddings ~40% of token volume, chat ~45%, rerank ~15% (subject to confirmation).

Immediate asks / action items:
1) Sofia: confirm the per-model split you expect for the pilot (chat/embeddings/rerank) and the approximate ramp timeline.
2) GlossAI procurement: share any contracting constraints (SOC2 addenda, PO cadence, procurement contacts).
3) Internal: Dev — can you draft a concise model-mix cost estimate (unit $/1M token) and a recommended Redwood model pairing for the pilot?

Attached: redwood_pricing_scenarios.xlsx (pricing scenarios by monthly token volume), model_mix_proposal.pdf (recommended model pairings & latency targets).

Proposed next step: 30-min follow-up next week to lock model splits and sign the mutual action plan so we can provision dedicated pilot capacity.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---

From: Sofia Chen <sofia.chen@glossai.com>
To: alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@glossai.com
Date: Sat, 4 Dec 2027 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap: token targets & proposed model blend (next steps)

Thanks Alex — good summary. A few clarifications from our side: we ran a quick check with product/eng to validate the pilot numbers. Updated details below.

Updated usage & budget:
- Pilot (months 0–2): ~450–550k tokens/month.
- Ramp months 3–6: linear increase to ~2.5M tokens/month.
- Long-term steady state (post-6mo): 1.8M–3.2M tokens/month depending on adoption.
- Budget: for pilot we can commit $2.5k–$4k/mo; if performance and cost hit targets, we have flexibility to expand to $6k+/mo.
- Our finance target: effective spend around $900–$1,200 per 1M tokens (inclusive of embeddings). That aligns with the ballpark you noted.

Per-model split (expected for pilot):
- Chat (conversational personalization): 45%
- Embeddings (upsert & vector search): 40%
- Rerank (candidate scoring): 15%

Questions for you:
1) Can Redwood provide a conservative and an aggressive unit-cost scenario per 1M tokens given that split?
2) Any SLA / burst capacity constraints for the pilot if we have short-term spikes?
3) Procurement: we prefer DocuSign for the MOU and standard PO afterward — procurement@glossai.com is the contact.

I'll attach a small sample of typical daily traffic (glossai_usage_sample.csv) so you can model request/sequence length distribution.

Best,
Sofia
Sofia Chen
Head of Product, GlossAI
---

From: dev.patel@redwoodinference.com
To: alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 4 Dec 2027 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Recap: token targets & proposed model blend (technical notes)

FW — quick technical read on Sofia's numbers and our recommended mapping. Notes below are internal.

Sofia's sample shows median sequence lengths: chat ~320 tokens per request, embeddings calls average ~120 tokens (batching expected), rerank short snippets ~60 tokens. That maps well to cost buckets.

Mapping and recommended Redwood models for the pilot (performance vs cost tradeoffs):
- Chat: redwood-chat-medium for core conversational flows (good latency/quality); redwood-chat-small as fallback for lower latency/cost for non-critical flows. Route 70% to medium, 30% to small.
- Embeddings: redwood-embed-large for recall-sensitive vectors; consider quantized redwood-embed-small for upsert-heavy operations. Expect batching to reduce per-call cost ~2–3x.
- Rerank: redwood-re-rank-sm (optimized rerank kernel) — very low per-token cost for short snippets.

Unit-cost scenarios (per 1M tokens) — rough internal estimates given the split Sofia proposed (45% chat / 40% embeddings / 15% rerank):
- Conservative (no batching, lower quantization): ~$1,350 per 1M tokens.
- Base (moderate batching, spot quantization): ~$1,050 per 1M tokens.
- Optimized (aggressive batching + quantized models for embeddings): ~$780 per 1M tokens.

Assumptions summarized:
- Chat tokens are more expensive per token than embeddings in our current catalog.
- Embeddings benefit significantly from batching and quantized execution paths.
- Rerank is low-cost but sensitive to latency; route to rerank pool with tight scheduling.

I'll prepare a short one-pager with the cost math broken down by model and token counts to share with GlossAI tomorrow.

— Dev
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
---

From: alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com
To: Sofia Chen <sofia.chen@glossai.com>, procurement@glossai.com
Cc: dev.patel@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 5 Dec 2027 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap: token targets & proposed model blend (next steps)

Sofia / procurement — thanks for the clarity and the sample file. Quick summary + proposal so we can lock timeline: 

What we heard from GlossAI:
- Pilot 450–550k tokens/month, ramp to ~2.5M by month 6.
- Preferred split (pilot): Chat 45% / Embeddings 40% / Rerank 15%.
- Finance target: $900–$1,200 per 1M tokens.

What Redwood will deliver for the pilot:
- Cost scenarios: we can commit to a baseline pricing band (DocuSign MOU) based on the Base scenario (~$1,050 per 1M tokens) with a performance discount if usage exceeds 2M tokens/mo within 90 days.
- Model plan: Dev's recommendation (redwood-chat-medium + fallback small, redwood-embed-large with quantized upserts, redwood-re-rank-sm) implemented as a routed serving policy.
- SLA & bursts: We can offer burst capacity for pilot (subject to canary + provisioning) — final SLA to be in MOU.

Next steps / asks:
1) Sofia: confirm you accept the proposed Base unit price (~$1,050 per 1M tokens) for the pilot MOU, or provide a counter target within your $900–$1,200 range.
2) Procurement: if MOU language is acceptable, we'll send a short DocuSign for the mutual action plan and pilot pricing (attached draft: MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_DRAFT.docx).
3) Dev: please send the one-pager cost math and a short traffic-to-provisioning checklist; we want that before the MOU is signed.

I'll leave a 30-min slot tomorrow afternoon for a final alignment call. If procurement prefers, we can proceed with DocuSign and lock the pilot start date once signed.

Best,
Alex
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

(Attachments referenced: redwood_pricing_scenarios.xlsx, model_mix_proposal.pdf, glossai_usage_sample.csv, MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_DRAFT.docx)
